content.title: Landman Season 3: Everything You Need To Know
content.text: Paramount+ Landman fan? Judging by the streaming ratings, odds are you are. Viewership of the Season 2 premiere was almost three times that of the Season 1 debut episode, which means Paramount+ really only had one choice: Bring back the Paramount+ original hit series, starring Billy Bob Thornton, for a third season. You need plenty of fuel to power this obsession of yours, and we’re happy to oblige. We’ve prepared a handy guide of everything there is to know right now about Landman Season 3, including release date info, returning cast list, and more. But first: SPOILER ALERT. We don’t want to be slick with you here. Plot points from the show’s first two seasons will be discussed. So, tread carefully – or, just go ahead, and binge-watch Season 1, and catch up on the latest episodes of Landman Season 2. Has Landman been renewed for Season 3? Yes, Landman has been renewed for Season 3, and is it any wonder? The show has struck Texas gold for Paramount+ . In its first two days on the service, the Landman Season 2 premiere scored more than 9.2 million streaming views, making it the most-watched premiere for any Paramount+ original series ever. What is the release date? The release date for Landman Season 3 has not yet been announced. For what it’s worth, Landman Season 1 and Landman Season 2 both launched in late fall. Here’s a look at those premiere dates: Landman Season 1 Premiere date: Nov. 17, 2024 No. of episodes: 10 Streaming: Paramount+ Landman Season 2 Premiere date: Nov. 16, 2025 Release schedule: New episodes are currently dropping weekly on Sundays, through the season finale on Jan. 18, 2026. Streaming: Paramount+ If the Landman Season 3 seems too far away, don’t worry: First off, as we noted above, new episodes of Landman Season 2 are still dropping through the season finale. And if that doesn’t fill your (oil) well, you can binge-watch all episodes of Landman Season 1 right now – yep – exclusively on Paramount+. What is the new season about? We don’t yet have details on what Landman Season 3 will be about. But considering that the show was co-created by Oscar® nominee Taylor Sheridan (1883, 1923, Lioness, Mayor of Kingstown, Tulsa King, Lawmen: Bass Reeves) and journalist Christian Wallace (Boomtown), and that its been firing on all cylinders for nearly two full seasons now, we’re pretty sure it’ll be nothing short of epic. Who’s in the cast? The Landman Season 3 cast has not yet been announced. Check back here for updates as the cast list is unveiled. Now, as Landman fans know, the show currently stars Oscar® winner Billy Bob Thornton as seen-it-all M-Tex Oil exec Tommy Norris. Here’s a complete look at the Landman regular-series cast for Season 2: Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris Demi Moore as Cami Miller Sam Elliott as T. L. Norris Andy Garcia as Gallino Ali Larter as Angela Norris Michelle Randolph as Ainsley Norris Jacob Lofland as Cooper Norris Kayla Wallace as Rebecca Falcone James Jordan as Dale Bradley Mark Collie as Sheriff Walt Joeberg Paulina Chávez as Ariana Colm Feore as Nathan Mustafa Speaks as Theodore “Boss” Ramone How many episodes will be in Landman Season 3? No announcement has been made about the number of episodes that will be in Landman Season 3. We can tell you, however, that Landman Season 1 had 10 episodes, and Landman Season 2 will have 10 episodes before it’s done. How to watch Landman Season 3 Landman Season 3 is set to stream exclusively on Paramount+. Landman Season 1 and the still-unfolding Landman Season 2 also stream exclusively on Paramount+. Do I need a Paramount+ subscription to watch Landman? Yes, you need a Paramount+ subscription to watch Landman. Landman is available to stream with any Paramount+ plan – either the ad-supported Paramount+ Essential plan, or the Paramount+ Premium plan, which has no ads (save for live TV), and includes the latest SHOWTIME® movies and shows. There are monthly and annual options for each subscription plan. Catch up on Landman: What happened in Seasons 1 and 2? SPOILER ALERT: Below, we will discuss Landman Season 1, and what we know so far about Landman Season 2. Proceed with caution!In Landman Season 1, we’re dropped into the oil fields of West Texas, and we meet the players of M-Tex Oil, including boots-on-the-ground exec Tommy Norris (Thornton), CEO Monty Miller (Jon Hamm), Monty’s wife Cami (Oscar® nominee Demi Moore), and Tommy’s earnest, entrepreneurial son Cooper (Jacob Lofland). By the season finale, with an ailing Monty on the verge of death, Tommy assumes the role of M-Tex president – and is terrorized by heavies from a Mexican drug cartel. In Landman Season 2, Cami steps out of her late husband’s shadow to assume control of M-Tex. Meanwhile, Tommy (who was spared a grisly fate by the cartel boss Gallino, played by Oscar® nominee Andy Garcia) juggles an ever-complicated work and home life, the latter of which now includes his father, T.L. (Oscar® nominee Sam Elliott). Cooper sees his oil fortunes rise – and his love life with Ariana (Paulina Chávez) move toward marriage. Landman Watch Now
